prompts.name: lighthouse
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent single-hex sailing board-game landmark, portrait canvas. Reference image: stylistic reference ONLY, the project's approved water-rich rock spire. Match its rich jewel colors, warm sunlit stone, cool shadows, crisp small details, dimensional premium adventure board-game illustration with painterly watercolor edges. Not faded historical watercolor. Elevated three-quarter overhead view, no horizon, no sky. Real transparent RGBA background, including all open water: show only the landmark and local irregular turquoise shallows/white foam with naturally broken soft alpha ends. No rectangular/hexagonal background, tile shape, border, text, grid, ship token, or labels. Keep all illustration and faint alpha fringes well inside canvas with generous transparent margins. This is a PASSABLE location: open transparent water must cross the field. Subject: ONE distinctive old white plaster lighthouse with warm red roof and red band, visible lantern glass, weathered tiny stair, on a SMALL craggy golden rock islet. Composition is crucial: cluster the entire tower and rock in the LEFT/REAR quadrant, approximately x=35%, y=40% of canvas; base near x=35%,y=55%. Small islet footprint, tall recognizable tower. Keep center, right half, and foreground almost completely transparent open sea as a generous continuous sailing passage. Do not center the island; do not broaden its rocky base across the cell.
